1.explanation: This Node script programmatically launches Chrome in headless mode via chrome-launcher and runs Lighthouse on the same URL that the reporter used, with only the “pwa” category enabled. When you execute `node reproduce-lh-hang.js`, Lighthouse will hang indefinitely at the “Loading page & waiting for onload” phase, reproducing the bug. You can swap `onlyCategories: ['pwa']` to other categories (e.g. `['performance']`) to confirm the hang only occurs for the PWA audit.
1.bug_scenario: When you run Lighthouse (either as a Chrome DevTools native audit or with the Lighthouse extension) on the URL https://nicolas-hoizey.com/2017/01/how-much-data-should-my-service-worker-put-upfront-in-the-offline-cache.html with only the “Progressive Web App” category enabled, Lighthouse never completes the “Loading page & waiting for onload” step. It spins indefinitely without throwing an error.
